_doc: Calibration map for engine-v1 on gemini-4-argon (substantial transformation), D160. Generated by eval/charts/build_accuracy.py from the development rows only; do not edit by hand.
rule: isotonic regression (pool-adjacent-violators) after pooling adjacent confidence values into blocks of at least 20 cases, capped at 0.99; a value between steps takes the step at or below it; a value under the lowest step takes the lowest step
bar_rule: lowest step with in-scope dev accuracy >= 96% on at least 100 cases
